G'oya

Mahallalar bo'yicha guruhlab, jami ko'chatlarni hisoblaymiz va natijani saralab, birinchi uchtasini olamiz. Saralashda uchta kalit bor: jami (kamayish), birinchi ekish kuni (o'sish) va nom. Birinchi ekish kuni guruhning MIN(planted_on) qiymati, uni SELECT ga chiqarmasdan ham ORDER BY da ishlatish mumkin.

Yechim

SELECT mahalla, SUM(saplings) AS saplings
FROM plantings
GROUP BY mahalla
ORDER BY SUM(saplings) DESC, MIN(planted_on), mahalla
LIMIT 3

Namunada Navruz, Bunyodkor va Chilonzor 200 tadan ekkan. Bunyodkor 1-martda boshlagan, Navruz 5-martda, Chilonzor 10-martda, shuning uchun tartib aynan shunday. Olmazorning 150 tasi to'rtinchi o'rin.

Tuzoqlar

Tenglikni faqat nom bilan hal qilish. Namunada Bunyodkor, Chilonzor, Navruz tartibi chiqadi, Chilonzor esa uchala mahalla ichida eng kech boshlagan:

Noto'g'riSELECT mahalla, SUM(saplings) AS saplings
FROM plantings
GROUP BY mahalla
ORDER BY SUM(saplings) DESC, mahalla
LIMIT 3

MAX(planted_on) oxirgi ekish kunini beradi, shartda esa birinchisi so'ralgan. LIMIT 3 ni unutsangiz, hamma mahalla chiqadi.
